problem.v: LLM agents hijacked by prompt injection when processing untrusted data

main_idea.v: Extract control/data flow from the trusted query; custom Python interpreter with provenance tags and policies; privileged vs quarantined LLM
main_idea.q: untrusted data retrieved by the LLM can never affect the program flow

threat_model.v: Untrusted tool outputs/web content injected into agent context
